description: Melee against a target with shield and parry.
DB, shield and parry all disabled although they have values.
Melee with 2 AP (-50) and a pace penalty partly offset by footwork.

deviations.note: Python passes the pace penalty through (footwork offset in melee only). Tactical computes pace -25/-50/-75 for every attack type, with footwork.

description: Ranged attack with 2 AP (-25), range penalty and a pace penalty with footwork (no offset outside melee).

deviations.note: Python passes the pace penalty through (footwork offset in melee only). Tactical computes pace -25/-50/-75 for every attack type, with footwork.

description: Ranged attack declared with 4 AP: Python yields +25 action points.

deviations.note: Python gives a positive bonus when AP exceed the base (4 melee / 3 ranged); tactical clamps the penalty at 0.

description: Thrown attack while engaged in melee: range penalty and range-in-melee.

deviations.note: Python has no 'thrown' type (its DTO rejects it). The fixture feeds it as 'ranged'.

description: Cramped restricted quarters (-50); a skill of 80 is capped at 50.
Confined restricted quarters (-100) with a negative skill bonus.
notes: min(|penalty|, skill) with a negative skill returns the skill itself, so the offset adds a further -15.

description: Melee attacker moving to the flank (-30, reverse-strike 20) against a flanked target (+15).
Melee to the rear (-70, reverse-strike 100 capped at 70) against the target's rear (+35).
Positional source and target are melee only: ignored on a ranged attack. Tight restricted quarters (-75) without skill still applies.
Melee against soft half cover (-20); a negative lethality is dropped (only > 0 counts) and a custom bonus is added.
Ranged against hard full cover (-200): the total is negative and the table roll clamps to 1.
Melee: prone attacker, target stunned, surprised and prone.
notes: Python accepts stunned and surprised together; tactical drops stunned when surprised is set.

description: Ranged: prone attacker, prone target (-30 outside melee) and hard partial cover (-40).
Off-hand weapon without ambidexterity (-20), close restricted quarters (-25) with skill 10, and the 'melee' source status (no range-in-melee for melee).
Off-hand with the ambidextrous status (+20) and the two-handed weapon flag (+10).
notes: Tactical always sends twoHandedWeapon=false and derives offHand from the attack name.
Ambidexterity is read from the source statuses, not from a talent.

description: Called shot to the head with no penalty given (defaults to -25) and called-shot skill 10; AT taken from headAt.
Ranged called shot to the legs with -40 and skill 60 (capped at 40); a global AT wins over legsAt.
No global AT: the hit location 'arms' selects armsAt.
No global AT and the tactical location 'chest': Python has no match and passes AT null.
notes: Python matches body/head/arms/legs only; tactical locations are head/chest/abdomen/arms/legs. chest/abdomen give at=None (fake uses 1).

description: Two attacks on two targets with multiple-attacks 30: both penalties offset separately.
notes: The same skill offsets attack-number and attack-targets, each capped on its own.

description: Three attacks on three targets, no skill (-100 and -40); size difference +1 adds no roll modifier, only the unused critical-severity entry; severity I splits into E, C and A.

deviations.note: Python: size-bonus = diff*5 only when diff < 0, plus an unused critical-severity entry. Tactical uses the real size difference as size-db and adjusts the critical roll.

description: Higher ground (+10, with a higher-ground skill), lethality, custom bonus, injury and fatigue.
notes: The skill offset on a positive bonus adds min(10, skill) on top. 'higher-ground' is not in tactical's combat skill list, so tactical never sends it.

description: Size difference -2: size-bonus -10 and a size-difference critical-severity entry.
notes: criticalSeverityModifiers is computed but never used to change the severity.

deviations.note: Python: size-bonus = diff*5 only when diff < 0, plus an unused critical-severity entry. Tactical uses the real size difference as size-db and adjusts the critical roll.

description: Total above 175: absolute hit ceil((t-175)/5), table roll clamps to 175, J critical splits in three, critical roll clamps to 100.
Attack size +1: damage x1.5 (rounded up) and severity E shifts to F, split into E and A.
Attack size -1: damage x0.5 (rounded up) and severity A shifts down to Z.
Roll within the fumble range: fumble, no table lookup, despite a high OB.
Roll one above the fumble range: normal resolution with no critical.
